description: This file is a Java interface named ProductImageService, defining methods for managing product images within an e-commerce application, including adding, retrieving, removing, and updating product images.

classes.name: ProductImageService
classes.description: A Java interface for managing product images, extending the SalesManagerEntityService for CRUD operations and adding specific image handling methods.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Adds a product image to persistence and the CMS.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves the image content and description from CMS, either by ProductImage object or by store code, product code, filename, and size.

methods.name: getProductImages
methods.description: Retrieves all images associated with a specific product.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a product image.

methods.name: addProductImages
methods.description: Adds multiple product images to a product.
